name: windy's nextbots (new custom gif nextbots!)
desc:
(Do you people really still play this?....)

A game inspired by gmod where you get chased by loud png's

Credits: nico's nextbots for most of the stuff. The rest of the credits are in the game's main menu.

I do not own the map. The map originally comes from nico's nextbots. (I was too lazy to make a map myself)

Press P or the panel button for custom nextbot creator panel (yes, this is a custom nextbot creator game similar to crazy's nextbots)

This game is still in beta! So expect some bugs and glitches at some point.

Note: the wind bux earnings are changed depending on how many nextbots there are so please do not beg others to remove or create nextbots just to grind wind bux. The wind bux is also only used to purchase bloxy colas for now.

Unfortunate note: this game is most likely discontinued due to my very little fascination with this quite, simple enough, project. It might still receive updates, just not big ones very often anymore. Sorry about that.

scripts.script:
local gameId = game.PlaceId
if gameId ~= 10858935202 then
    return print("Wrong game Buddy")
end

local player = game:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Players").LocalPlayer
local Uis = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
local FirstUi = Uis:FindFirstChild("CreateBotGui")
local Frame = FirstUi:FindFirstChild("Frame")
local Options = Frame:FindFirstChild("OptionsFrame")
local BasicOption = Options:FindFirstChild("BasicOptions")
local BO = BasicOption

local function CheckExistence(class)
    return class ~= nil
end

local COne = CheckExistence(Uis)
if not COne then
    return print("No Ui?")
end

task.wait()

local NameFilter = BO:FindFirstChild("NameBox"):FindFirstChild("FilterScript")
if NameFilter then
    NameFilter.Enabled = false
else
    return print("Buddy Rejoin or You just Deleted it")
end

local NextbotsLimit = Frame:FindFirstChild("TextButton"):FindFirstChild("LocalScript"):FindFirstChild("Limit")
if NextbotsLimit then
    NextbotsLimit.Value = 1000000000000000000
else
    return print("Buddy Rejoin or You just Deleted it")
end

print("The Script was Successful So Enjoy the Script Bud \n Made by x84dbg On Discord or NutShellScriptForRea On Scriptblox. \n Executed On The Time: " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %X") .. "\n In case You Forget the Link The Link is Copied in Your Clipboard")

if setclipboard then
    setclipboard("https://scriptblox.com/script/windy's-nextbots-(new-custom-gif-nextbots!)-Create-Nextbot-Bypasser-30900")
elseif toclipboard then
    toclipboard("https://scriptblox.com/script/windy's-nextbots-(new-custom-gif-nextbots!)-Create-Nextbot-Bypasser-30900")
end
